g.text: return new AbstractTextBlock(){public void drawU(UGraphicug){if (compact){final doubletitleHeight=title.calculateDimension(ug.getStringBounder()).getHeight();final doubledy=(getRibbonHeight()-titleHeight)/2;title.drawU(ug.apply(UTranslate.dy(dy)));}}public XDimension2DcalculateDimension(StringBounderstringBounder){doublewidth=getInitialWidth(stringBounder);if (compact)width+=title.calculateDimension(stringBounder).getWidth()+10;return new XDimension2D(width,getRibbonHeight());}};
